requirements.text: You have 1–5 years of software engineering experience and you’ve built backend applications that real people use
You’re strong in TypeScript and PostgreSQL, with solid fundamentals and a good grasp of OOP
You build things for fun: side projects, shipped apps, hackathons, early-stage internships
You learn fast, spot problems before anyone asks, and come with a fix rather than a question
You want the pace, responsibility and steep learning curve that only an early-stage company gives you
A CS or Software Engineering degree (or similar) is a plus, but what you’ve built matters more

Manhattan , NYC (Financial District). This is a full-time, on-site role working in the office, 5 days per week. Not based in New York? No worries — all expenses will be covered for interviews and meetings, and you'll be well supported by the team throughout your move to New York.
